01-searcher--Searcher

Pilot a ship through terrain and shoot targets while collecting points.

Source: original website snapshot Searcher.z80 from supplied archive, unchanged.
Archive-derived TZX: Searcher.tzx.
This TZX was built by the source archive and is not an original website tape.
Listing: Searcher.bas independently decoded with build/tools/zx-tzx2bas.py
from the archived TZX, not copied from any supplied BAS.
Control information: KEYS-AND-TIMING.txt (from the archive line audit).
Replay: sh BASIC/REPLAY.sh; requires Fuse SDL, Xvfb, Python Pillow and python-xlib.
SCREENSHOTS/01-STATE.png and 02-AFTER-FIRE-AND-DOWN.png are actual
Fuse gameplay frames, captured after ENTER to start and four keyboard
actions (7, 8, 9, 6) verified against BASIC lines 120-132 and 8020-8029.
This is a short recorded gameplay sequence, not a full playthrough.
No native RBC build. bin/ reserved for later, not tracked by Git.
